dedupe_keys.name: cityscape critical systems modeling commons netlogo city model with road rail and air traffic and event response

description: A NetLogo simulation built as a thesis to illustrate implementing critical-systems protocols with the CitySCAPE framework, published on Modeling Commons. Contents: a virtual city with ongoing road traffic (people, cars, buses and trucks chosen by sliders), pedestrians, one airport with a single air route for aeroplanes, railroad traffic and a hospital placed in a random building at setup. Users deploy events and watch the city's critical response, for example an aeroplane crash that affects the nearest building or road, or a quarantine declared around a building. Producer: George-Alexandru Serea, Bucharest, presented at the Politehnica University of Bucharest on 11 July 2013. Coverage: a synthetic city. Format and access: NetLogo 5.1.0 file (CitySCAPE_Critical_Systems.nlogo, uploaded 24 March 2015) that runs in the browser or in NetLogo. Licence: the info tab allows use and modification if a visible reference to the original author and university is kept. Caveats: the author lists minimal traffic (no traffic lights), one airport and one aerial route, and a delay in setting up quarantine areas; a teaching demonstration, not a calibrated model. Simulation uses: illustrating event response across transport and building systems. Related records: none identified.
